name: Hot Toddy
desc: Whiskey, honey and lemon juice topped with hot water in a warm mug.

source.title: Hot Toddy
source.evidence: Same five ingredients at the same base amounts (3/4 cup hot water, 1 1/2 oz whiskey, 2 tsp each lemon juice and honey, lemon round); this version gives a 2 to 3 tsp range.

steps: Fill an 8 oz mug with hot tap water to warm it while you heat the water, then pour it out.
Bring the 3/4 cup water to a simmer in a small saucepan or kettle, then take it off the heat.
Add the whiskey, 2 tsp honey and 2 tsp lemon juice to the warm mug.
Pour the hot water over the top and stir until the honey dissolves. Taste and add up to 1 tsp more honey or lemon.
Garnish with the lemon round and serve right away.
tips: A cinnamon stick or a few whole cloves in the mug add spice (Love and Lemons).

references.title: Hot Toddy
references.usedFor: base amounts, cinnamon stick or clove garnish

references.title: Perfect Hot Toddy
